The web_search backend (DuckDuckGo/searx) returned 'Connection refused' on every attempt for the whole session, so no OFAC SDN / UN / EU / UK / BIS Entity List screening, no Indian court (eCourts, Bombay HC, NCLT) search, no credit-rating lookup (CRISIL/ICRA/CARE/India Ratings) and no negative-news search could be executed. All risk fields are therefore null, NOT confirmed-clean. Only source actually read: company homepage https://www.francoindian.com/ (fetched successfully) - it self-describes Franco-Indian Pharmaceuticals Pvt. Ltd. (FIPPL), founded 1949, HQ Mumbai, ~2000 employees, 'over 400 crore turnover', exports formulations to Asia and Africa and claims reach into UK, France and USA. These are company self-statements only, not verified facts. No mention of Russia or CIS markets on the homepage; the site's 'Global Presence'/'Markets' subpages returned HTTP 404, so the export-geography claim could not be checked. Note the homepage carries a large block of injected SEO spam links (fake Oakley/Louboutin/GHD/MBT links) and states 'Website updated on 10 September 2014' - i.e. the site is stale and partly compromised, so it is not a reliable compliance source. No sanctions, court, regulator, rating or Russia/CIS supply evidence was found or ruled out. Recommend re-running this company once search access is restored.
